races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Fillies Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)

runners_data.name: Alpha
runners_data.spotlight: Sea The Stars filly is closely related to 1m2f-1m6f winner Saturn (inc AW; RPR 98), half-sister to 7.5f winner Proxima Centauri (87); dam 6f-1m winner (inc 2yo/Irish 1,000 Guineas; 124), half-sister to 1m Group 1 winner Alpine Star, from fine family of Miesque; super pedigree.

runners_data.name: Alpine Wedding
runners_data.spotlight: Sioux Nation filly cost 115,000euros as a foal and 220,000euros as a yearling; sister to 6.5f and 7f (French Group 3) 2yo winner Sydneyarms Chelsea (RPR 96), half-sister to 6f AW winner Bucklow Hill (74); dam 6f AW 2yo winner (75), out of Group-placed 6f 2yo winner; top yard, obvious appeal on debut.

runners_data.name: Blonde Over Blue
runners_data.spotlight: Lope De Vega filly cost 260,000gns as a foal and 400,000gns as a yearling; first foal; dam 1m1f-1m4f winner (inc AW/Italian Group 3; RPR 105), half-sister to Japanese 1m2f winner Steen; newcomer represents another top yard, has to be noted for market support.

runners_data.name: Carafinn
runners_data.spotlight: Mehmas filly cost 120,000euros as a yearling; half-sister to winners Warriors Whisper (French Group-placed 9.5f AW; RPR 98) and Carencey (6f/7f; 82); dam 7f-1m2f winner (inc Group 3; 105), sister to dam of top-class middle-distance performer Pyledriver; watch for market support on debut.

runners_data.name: Honey Deuce
runners_data.spotlight: St Mark's Basilica filly cost 90,000euros as a yearling; half-sister to winners Magda (French 8.5f 2yo/1m2f) and Dubai First (Norwegian 1m4f); dam French 10.5f-12.5f winner (inc AW/Listed; RPR 105), out of unraced half-sister to Breeders' Cup Juvenile winner Wilko; watch market.

runners_data.name: Ibelieveicanfly
runners_data.spotlight: Frankel filly is closely related to 1m-10.6f winner Piz Badile (inc 2yo/AW/Group 3; RPR 116), half-sister to 6f/7f winner Yosemite Valley (inc Listed; 117); dam 1m1f-10.5f winner (inc AW/Listed; 105), out of 10.5f Group 1 winner from fine family; Ryan Moore's pick and yard have won this for the last three years.

runners_data.name: Littlepacer
runners_data.spotlight: Dark Angel filly cost 23,000euros as a foal and 20,000euros as a yearling; half-sister to winners Havana Rum (5f/6f inc 2yo/AW; RPR 87) and Armada Rising (US 1m turf); dam unraced half-sister to US 1m Grade 1 winner Hunt.

runners_data.name: Pink Venom
runners_data.spotlight: Soldier's Call filly a 85,000euros yearling; third foal; half-sister to 6f/7f 2yo winner Rebel Diamond (inc Listed/Qatar; RPR 98); dam unraced half-sister to winners Sollertia (7f 2yo), The Ginger Queen (US 7.5f/1m) and Szachrajka (Polish 7f/1m); debutante likely all the better for the experience.

runners_data.name: Westminster Waltz
runners_data.spotlight: Churchill filly cost 25,000euros as a yearling; half-sister to four winners inc Take Me With You (Group-placed 6f 2yo; RPR 96), Just Ain't Right (US stakes-placed 6f dirt) and Is It True Ma'am (US 6f dirt 2yo); unraced dam out of US 6f Grade 3 2yo winner; debutante probably best watched.

runners_data.name: Margot Mae
runners_data.comment: A 115,000gns yearling; by a quality sire and related to lots of winners so check market
runners_data.spotlight: Starspangledbanner filly a 115,000gns yearling; half-sister to winners incl' New Endeavour (7f-1m1f inc 2yo/AW/Australian Group 3; RPR 117), and Johnny Boom (8.6f-1m4f inc AW; 80); dam unraced half-sister to 7f 2yo Group 3 winner Luminous Eyes; plenty keen and green on Navan debut in late April; given a break since and more expected of.

runners_data.name: Chiquitita Bee
runners_data.comment: E12,000 State Of Rest filly, dam runner up 6f (2yo), market check advised
runners_data.spotlight: State Of Rest filly; 12,000euros yearling; second foal; dam runner-up 6f 2yo (RPR 82), half-sister to Italian 1m7f jumps winner Teddy's Profit, out of French 1m2f winning half-sister to 5f/5.5f 2yo Group 2 winner Signora Cabello; plenty keen, dropped out to finish last of 9 on recent Cork debut; this a stronger maiden, easily passed over.

races.name: BOYLE Sports Apprentice Handicap

runners_data.name: Bella Isabella
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with strong 7f form who should get ideal positioning behind the uncontested leader
runners_data.comment: M'den winner ran a decent race in second h'cap in final start last term; needs more
runners_data.spotlight: Cork maiden winner (7f, good) last season went on to take third of eight in a  Group 3 next time (7f, good); finished around 2l behind today's rival Mallavelly (third) when seventh of 20 in a 1m premier handicap here on her final start last term; well beaten on seasonal debut at Naas

runners_data.name: Mehman
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer who needs a strong pace and clear run, may struggle if gallop stays moderate
runners_data.comment: Won over 5f at this meeting in 2024 off 1lb lower, solid 1m run  on latest, can't discount
runners_data.spotlight: Four-time AW winner, sole turf success came in 5f handicap at Naas in May 2024; solid effort when over 1m at Bellewstown in April and backed that up with a close third over 6f at Naas last month; 1-22 record on turf is a concern but those recent efforts have been encouraging

runners_data.name: Flaming Rib
runners_data.note: Prominent type returning from 169-day break, needs to prove fitness after long absence
runners_data.spotlight: Seven wins in Britain; runner-up for Hugo Palmer in 2022 Commonwealth Cup at Royal Ascot; regressive since 2023; improved from a moderate stable debut last September when close fourth in a 7f rated at Dundalk in November; last of ten at the same venue in December; rated 113 at his peak, now down to 79 but remains risky.

runners_data.name: Mallavelly
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with excellent course record who can quicken well if pace develops properly
runners_data.comment: Out of her depth on comeback run nine days ago, considered back at her level here
runners_data.spotlight: Progressive in handicaps last year; went up an aggregate 11lb for wins here and Tipperary and ended season with a fine third in a premier handicap at this venue (Bella Isabella, seventh); sights lowered again after a 1m Group 3 bid here on return; definite chance.

runners_data.name: Dark Viper
runners_data.note: Specialist over longer trips at this course, 7f may be inadequate for his patient style
runners_data.comment: 2-22 but runner-up nine times; decent return last time but Vega's Muse is number one
runners_data.spotlight: Has recorded his only two wins over 1m at this venue; ground was heavy when he scored off this mark last October, his 2024 win was on good going; his record of finishing second ten times strikes a note of caution; below best in three 2026 appearances.

runners_data.name: Eddie G
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner returning from 380-day layoff, tongue tie applied suggests breathing issues addressed
runners_data.comment: Both wins have come on the AW (6f/7f) but has been competitive on turf
runners_data.spotlight: Two AW wins, 0-11 on turf; ran only twice last season; denied a clear run when third of 14 on his seasonal reappearance in first-time tongue time at Roscommon; failed to build on that Cork eight days later and absent since.

runners_data.name: Playin Cool
runners_data.note: Prominent runner whose 1m1f maiden win suggests this shorter trip may not suit
runners_data.comment: Ended last season with a 1m1f maiden win, may step up from his 1m run here in March
runners_data.spotlight: Ended last season with a 1m1f course maiden win on heavy ground; yet to make an impact in handicaps; trip might be inadequate.

runners_data.name: Great Mover
runners_data.note: Prominent type whose heavy ground form questions her effectiveness on this surface
runners_data.comment: Has been unable to match the form she showed in the final months of last season
runners_data.spotlight: Only win from 20 starts came on heavy ground at Gowran last September; has failed to retrieve her best form in four outings this term, though she was aimed high in the Irish Lincoln and was not beaten far in sixth over 1m at Limerick on her penultimate start; down in trip again after a 1m2f run here last time, eased when beaten.

runners_data.name: Loingseoir
runners_data.note: Veteran hold-up performer making rare Leopardstown visit, prefers other tracks
runners_data.spotlight: Durable veteran, 7-74, placed 13 times; recorded his most recent win last autumn; best form at the Curragh and Fairyhouse; makes a rare visit to Leopardstown, placed on both starts here; two mid-division runs this season; retains ability

runners_data.name: Thru And Thru
runners_data.note: Uncontested leader returning from 50-day break with tongue tie, controls the race tempo
runners_data.comment: Beaten just 1l on h'cap debut last time; Keane takes over now and looks a big player
runners_data.spotlight: Lightly-raced filly; second twice in maidens and made a bright start in handicaps when third of 12 over 7f at Naas in March; something seemingly amiss when favourite here in April, though vet's report revealed nothing; may bounce back now.

runners_data.name: Send Harry
runners_data.note: Prominent runner whose best form came over 6f, stamina questions at this longer trip
runners_data.spotlight: Dependable on turf last summer, when his form included two Curragh placings over 6f; subsequently won over today's trip on Dundalk AW; possible that he will step up on the form of last month's outings at the Curragh and Cork.

races.paceDynamic: Thru And Thru will set the pace unchallenged with no other confirmed front runners in the field. Bella Isabella, Flaming Rib, Playin Cool, Great Mover and Send Harry will sit prominent, but none are aggressive enough to pressure the leader early. This creates a sustainable gallop that will suit horses with tactical speed who can quicken from handy positions. The lack of early pressure clearly favours prominent runners and those with finishing kicks over pure hold-up horses.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustainable Pace Favours Prominents
scenarios.trigger: If Thru And Thru sets an uncontested lead without pressure from the prominent group
scenarios.body: The moderate early gallop allows prominent runners to travel comfortably before delivering their challenge in the final two furlongs. Horses like Bella Isabella and Mallavelly can position perfectly to strike when the pace lifts.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Leader Kicks Clear
scenarios.trigger: If Thru And Thru builds an unassailable advantage and the prominent group fails to close
scenarios.body: The front runner exploits the lack of early pace pressure to establish a commanding lead that proves insurmountable. Her tactical speed off the steady gallop catches the field napping in the closing stages.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Charge From Behind
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is genuinely slow and the hold-up horses get perfect splits in the straight
scenarios.body: The crawling gallop sets up a sprint finish where horses with the strongest finishing kick can overcome their poor positioning. Mehman and Dark Viper benefit from their patient tactics when gaps appear late.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Prominent Duel Develops
scenarios.trigger: If Bella Isabella or Flaming Rib take the race to Thru And Thru from halfway
scenarios.body: The injection of pace from the prominent runners creates a true test of stamina over the final three furlongs. This faster gallop plays into the hands of horses who stay strongly at this trip.

watchPoints.text: Thru And Thru could steal this if she gets an easy lead and none of the prominent group challenges early enough
Mehman and Dark Viper need the pace to develop strongly to bring their finishing kicks into play
Flaming Rib and Eddie G face significant fitness questions after extended breaks from racing
Bella Isabella's positioning behind the leader will be crucial to her chances of timing her challenge
The opening furlong will reveal if any prominent runners plan to pressure Thru And Thru early

races.name: King George V Cup (Listed Race)

runners_data.name: Endorsement
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with strong form figures but faces tactical disadvantage if pace crawls with no genuine leader
runners_data.spotlight: Second to the current Derby favourite Benvenuto Cellini on debut at Killarney; best display at two when second to Pierre Bonnard in the Zetland Stakes; this year's course form involves links to Derby candidates; stuck to his task to take second when Pierre Bonnard flopped in the Ballysax; pick of these on his close third behind James J Braddock and Pierre Bonnard in the Derby Trial.

runners_data.name: Amadeus Mozart
runners_data.note: Fellow prominent horse who must take initiative to create suitable race shape for his style against hold-up opponents
runners_data.spotlight: Made a winning debut in a 7f maiden at the Curragh last June; no match for Godolphin's Maho Bay in a novice event at Newmarket in April (winner a beaten favourite in the Lingfield Derby Trial on next start); looked in need of further when failing to make an impact in the 1m2f Gallinule Stakes won by stablemate Causeway.

runners_data.name: Emmeleia
runners_data.spotlight: Non-runner

runners_data.name: So Must I
runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist perfectly positioned to benefit from likely slow early pace in weak field
runners_data.spotlight: Winner of a middle-distance Dundalk conditions race in February; subsequent form in turf handicaps does not inspire confidence at this level.

runners_data.name: Yousaynothingatall
runners_data.note: Another hold-up performer whose tactical advantage increases significantly without confirmed leader Emmeleia
runners_data.spotlight: Handicap mark unchanged on 80 after a maiden win at Cork a month on her fifth start; safely held by Emmeleia on running at Dundalk in April.

races.paceDynamic: With Emmeleia withdrawn, no natural front-runners remain in this small field of five. Both Endorsement and Amadeus Mozart adopt prominent positions but neither will truly lead from the start, creating a pedestrian early pace. The lack of genuine pace-setters means the tempo will be controlled and tactical, with acceleration coming late. This setup strongly favours hold-up horses who can unleash a finishing kick, giving So Must I and Yousaynothingatall a significant tactical advantage over the prominent runners.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Tactical Hold-Up Sprint
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace crawls with no genuine leader emerging from the prominent pair.
scenarios.body: The lack of tempo allows hold-up horses to conserve energy and deliver maximum finishing kicks in the straight. So Must I and Yousaynothingatall can position perfectly off the dawdling pace.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Moderate Pace Sustained
scenarios.trigger: If Endorsement or Amadeus Mozart takes early initiative to ensure reasonable gallop.
scenarios.body: A moderate tempo prevents the race becoming a pure sprint finish while still allowing prominent horses to maintain position. The O'Brien prominent runners can control proceedings without facing devastating late kicks.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Early Tactical Battle
scenarios.trigger: If both prominent horses refuse to lead early creating a stop-start tempo.
scenarios.body: Jockeys play cat-and-mouse through the first half before someone blinks and quickens the pace. The uneven tempo disrupts all running styles but favours the most adaptable.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Surprise Early Pace
scenarios.trigger: If Amadeus Mozart or Endorsement surprisingly commits to strong early gallop.
scenarios.body: An unexpectedly strong pace stretches the field and creates genuine stamina test over 1m4f. The faster tempo plays into the hands of horses with proven staying power.

watchPoints.text: Watch if both Endorsement and Amadeus Mozart refuse early leadership creating crawling pace that devastates prominent runners
Monitor Amadeus Mozart's willingness to commit early as only realistic pace-maker after Emmeleia's withdrawal
Observe So Must I's positioning as he represents most natural beneficiary of tactical scenario
Check if either prominent runner breaks tactical deadlock before halfway stage to create workable tempo
Watch Yousaynothingatall's closing kick development as slow pace maximises her finishing weapon effectiveness

races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Median Auction Fillies Maiden

runners_data.name: Fleur De Provence
runners_data.spotlight: Easy to back 16-1, made a promising debut over 1m at Naas in late March when staying on to finish second behind the Aidan O'Brien-trained favourite Drop Dead Gorgeous, despite running green; failed to uphold form with fourth-placed Sanctijude at Gowran last month; longer trip may make the difference now.

runners_data.name: An Cailleach
runners_data.comment: Sixth foal; half-sister to several winners but can only be watched on debut
runners_data.spotlight: Completely tailed off first time out at Gowran eight weeks ago; can be ignored.

runners_data.name: Mawhibah
runners_data.spotlight: Tenth foal; Australia filly is closely related to a minor handicap winner, much more interesting as a half-sister to Group 1 sprint winner Librisa Breeze; dam 1m2f winner.

runners_data.name: My Girl Grace
runners_data.spotlight: Fifth foal; half-sister by Ghaiyyath to multiple winners Croupier (four races, RPR 108) and Touchwood (five races, RPR 83); dam unraced sister to 7f 2yo Group 2 winner Saamidd.

runners_data.name: Ventriloquist
runners_data.spotlight: E8,500 yearling; fourth foal; half-sister to winners, notably Serious Challenge (Listed-placed and also a useful hurdler), and Group 3 sprint winner Dawn Charger.

runners_data.name: Shanala
runners_data.spotlight: Looked very raw when introduced at Gowran last month; likely to improve but perhaps not by enough to win here.

runners_data.name: Lake Bonney
runners_data.comment: Encouraging effort on debut at Leopardstown, improvement likely upped in trip, player
runners_data.spotlight: Encouraging effort on debut over 1m at this venue in April, keeping on from midfield for fourth of 14; will be no surprise if she improved sufficiently to turn the tables on the runner-up Bang Bang.

runners_data.name: Donna Time
runners_data.spotlight: Left an impression she would improve from the run when introduced at Dundalk in January; beaten around 7l in seventh in what looked like an ordinary contest

runners_data.name: Churchfield Lady
runners_data.comment: Churchill filly, closely related to Italian 6f winner, trip might stretch stamina
runners_data.spotlight: Pedigree implies she might have a stamina issue over this trip; that view is endorsed by her debut run at Cork when she ran out of steam over a furlong down.

runners_data.name: Path To Peace
runners_data.spotlight: Slowly away, never in contention when a 66-1 chance on debut here last month; visored now.

runners_data.name: Tintinabulla
runners_data.spotlight: 100-1, never involved first time out at the Curragh; highly unlikely to feature.

runners_data.name: Bang Bang
runners_data.spotlight: Slow to break but shaped reasonably well over 7f here on debut last July when staying on strongly into fifth, having run green; not beaten far when fifth of nine over the same trip at the Galway festival; no match for the well-fancied Mixed Feelings in a 1m maiden here in April; not guaranteed to uphold form with fourth-placed Lake Bonney.

runners_data.name: Stellar Moment
runners_data.comment: Ulysses filly; dam 7f AW 2yo winner (RPR 88), half-sister to 6f winner; best watched
runners_data.spotlight: Failed to cope with testing ground first time out at the Curragh in March; best watched.

runners_data.name: Freedom And Light
runners_data.comment: Better latest (150-1) when stepping up to this trip, beaten 9l by smart type; more needed
runners_data.spotlight: Ordinary form in maidens; ran poorly in a conditions race at Naas last time. eased after chance had gone; officially rated 9lb inferior to Fleur De Provence.

races.name: BOYLE Sports 'Home Of The Early Payout' Handicap

runners_data.name: Son Of Beauty
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who stayed on well over 1m last time but 38 days off and needs to prove he can handle faster company in this grade
runners_data.comment: Beaten around 5l in Madrid Handicap here over 7f; better ground this time will help.
runners_data.spotlight: AW maiden winner over 1m in early March and just fair efforts since in Naas handicaps, beaten around 5l in Madrid Handicap (7f) and stayed on late over 1m when beaten under 4l in premier handicap in late April; up another furlong in trip here and needs to improve for it.

runners_data.name: Sunrush
runners_data.note: Prominent racer returning from seasonal break with only fair recent form, trainer's 10% strike rate a concern despite home track advantage
runners_data.spotlight: Last month's seasonal return here (1m) was okay but nothing to suggest he'll make an immediate impact in handicaps off this mark, albeit has to be respected from a yard having a great season.

runners_data.name: How'sthebai
runners_data.note: Classic hold-up horse with proven class who ran well fresh at Naas, Colin Keane booking suggests stable confidence despite 38-day break
runners_data.spotlight: Off the mark in 1m AW maiden in October on last of three juvenile outings; very promising seasonal return in 1m Naas premier handicap in late April, staying on well in closing stages when beaten 1l into fourth (Son Of Beauty 2.75l away fifth); big player given normal improvement and longer trip.

runners_data.name: Red Autumn
runners_data.note: Natural front runner who handles soft ground well but 74 days since last run creates fitness doubts in competitive handicap
runners_data.comment: M'den winner (good) ran well at Roscommon before bad run at Listowel; others preferred
runners_data.spotlight: Won Bellewstown maiden last year and decent second in Roscommon winners' contest, best efforts; encouraging comeback run in Madrid Handicap at Naas in late March, staying on late into fourth over inadequate 7f; step up in trip seems sure to suit and top-weight should go well.

runners_data.name: Ryefield Dasher
runners_data.note: Promising 2-year-old making seasonal return after 214 days off, prominent style suits but long absence and step up in class questions
runners_data.spotlight: Cheaply bought Time Test colt showed fair form in three outings late last season, latter two in good-class Curragh maidens when intimating a step up in trip would suit; lack of a recent run a concern here on seasonal return and handicap debut.

runners_data.name: Johnny Soda
runners_data.note: Recent winner who didn't stay 1m2f last time, suggesting this intermediate trip could be ideal for his prominent racing style
runners_data.comment: Stayed on strongly to win at Cork (1m), up 5lb, go well again if handles quicker ground
runners_data.spotlight: Breakthrough win at Cork (1m, soft) last month when coming late (beating a subsequent winner); didn't appear to stay 1m2f at Navan 13 days later, this intermediate trip could suit.

runners_data.name: Monvoe
runners_data.note: In-form hold-up horse with back-to-back wins including impressive latest success, perfectly suited by expected pace scenario
runners_data.comment: Built on his useful AW form when winning at Limerick last month, can remain competitive
runners_data.spotlight: Rapid improver of late, twice runner-up on AW last autumn and has reappeared for back-to-back wins in 1m handicaps at Limerick and when running away late on under today's rider here last month; every chance of staying this extra furlong and could still have more to offer despite 16lb rise for two wins.

runners_data.name: Sweet Baby Zou
runners_data.note: Just won over longer trip with new headgear but quick turnaround after Monday's win and tendency to fade late remains concerning
runners_data.comment: Beaten favourite at Down Royal on Friday, 7f looked inadequate then, may do better now
runners_data.spotlight: Step up in trip and first-time cheekpieces brought improvement when getting off the mark over slightly further at Gowran on Monday (two days after being well held at Down Royal) on easier ground, winning comfortably having hit the front some way out (first two clear); quick return under mandatory 7lb penalty and could be hard to beat on similar ground.

races.paceDynamic: Red Autumn is the only confirmed front runner in this 8-runner field, likely to get an uncontested lead with Sunrush, Ryefield Dasher and Johnny Soda settling prominently behind him. The soft ground and 1m1f trip will create a sustainable tempo early with the real test coming in the final 3f when the hold-up horses How'sthebai, Son Of Beauty, Monvoe and Sweet Baby Zou attempt to close. With only one horse wanting the lead and several proven late finishers including recent winners Monvoe and Sweet Baby Zou, this pace setup strongly favours hold-up horses who can deliver their challenge in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Red Autumn sets modest fractions on the soft ground
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace allows the closers to wind up perfectly, with Monvoe and Sweet Baby Zou best placed to exploit their finishing kicks. The prominent racers get outpaced when the tempo lifts approaching the home turn.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front rank control
scenarios.trigger: If Red Autumn maintains a strong gallop throughout or Sunrush/Johnny Soda press forward
scenarios.body: The sustained pace stretches the field and prevents the hold-up horses from getting into contention. Red Autumn or one of the prominent racers can kick clear in the straight.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Tactical mess benefits patient
scenarios.trigger: If multiple horses challenge Red Autumn early creating a muddled pace
scenarios.body: The stop-start tempo plays into the hands of the most patient finishers who can navigate traffic. How'sthebai's class tells under these circumstances with Colin Keane steering through gaps.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Surprise front rank upset
scenarios.trigger: If Red Autumn doesn't handle the soft conditions or fades dramatically
scenarios.body: Ryefield Dasher or Johnny Soda inherit the lead and find enough stamina reserves for the extended trip. The hold-up horses leave their runs too late on ground that's riding slower than expected.

watchPoints.text: Sweet Baby Zou carrying a penalty after Monday's win and historically fades in the finish, making the quick turnaround highly questionable
Red Autumn's 74-day absence could prove costly if others press him early, particularly if the ground is riding softer than advertised
Ryefield Dasher making seasonal debut after 214 days off and facing much stronger opposition than his juvenile campaigns
How'sthebai needs Colin Keane to secure early cover from his wide draw to deliver his proven late kick effectively
Monvoe's recent winning form suggests he's the hold-up horse most likely to handle any increase in tempo

races.name: BOYLE Sports Best Odds From 8am Handicap

runners_data.name: Booyea
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer whose best form came in this grade at this course, returning from 18-day break with cheekpieces back on
runners_data.comment: Best runs last year came in cheekpieces but that headgear is not applied here
runners_data.spotlight: Best run last year when second in valuable C&D handicap (good to firm) in first-time cheekpieces off 90; form regressed afterwards but encouraging seasonal return (well-backed) at Naas last month over 1m; down in grade here off a fair mark so one to consider.

runners_data.name: Coul Dreamer
runners_data.note: Prominent racer winless in nine Flat starts but has been placed recently and drops significantly in grade
runners_data.comment: Won a juvenile hurdle in 2024, fair Flat form, poor display in a 1m4f handicap in March
runners_data.spotlight: Winning hurdler but 0-9 on the Flat, placed in Clonmel maiden over today's trip last season and more recently staying on third over 1m in Killarney maiden last month; needs to improve on previous handicap efforts though.

runners_data.name: Harana
runners_data.note: Lightly-raced prominent runner returning from 24 days off, may need this run after 13-month absence before last start
runners_data.spotlight: Very lightly raced 4yo; promising debut second in 1m Gowran maiden last year, absent for 13 months until third in Roscommon maiden last month over 1m4f, weakening late; back in trip for handicap debut with potential for improvement.

runners_data.name: Sonoran
runners_data.note: Prominent racer who ran well over 1m2f here last month but faces 2lb rise in the weights with tongue-tie fitted
runners_data.comment: Things have gone downhill since starting his career with a win and a second
runners_data.spotlight: Won 7f Tipperary maiden on debut a year ago; hasn't won since in seven starts although best effort here last month when close third over 1m2f; 2lb higher and wide draw a negative.

runners_data.name: Molto Amichi
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse returning from 53-day break, maiden but has placed several times including at this course and distance
runners_data.comment: Maiden ran well here last summer, faller over hurdles when last seen, best watched
runners_data.spotlight: Maiden placed several times last year including over C&D off 77; last month's comeback run here (1m) should have brought him on.

runners_data.name: Pillar Of Hope
runners_data.note: Hold-up veteran with five wins but struggling to recapture form this season, apprentice jockey reduces weight
runners_data.comment: Course 1m4f winner during a solid 2025 campaign, below his best in two outings this term
runners_data.spotlight: Five turf wins, most recently here over 1m2f last October off 70; yet to hit form this season however and remains opposable.

runners_data.name: Walhaan
runners_data.note: Front-running 10-year-old with course and distance win, returning from long break after seasonal return was over inadequate trip
runners_data.comment: Seven-time Flat winner has shown generally moderate form over timber since winning in 2023
runners_data.spotlight: Seven Flat wins include over C&D, and more recently on the AW in December; trip inadequate on seasonal return here in April and has since been pulled up over hurdles; champion jockey booked but veteran appears vulnerable.

runners_data.name: Daler
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner who got first win on all-weather but turf return last month was disappointing for top connections
runners_data.comment: Just fair efforts since first win on AW in October; could go well back on turf
runners_data.spotlight: Got first career win with comfortable 1m Dundalk handicap success in October off 72; just fair efforts on AW afterwards and turf return at Naas last month was just okay (keen); cheekpieces now added.

runners_data.name: No More Porter
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer better over shorter trips, unfavorably drawn and questionable at this extended distance
runners_data.comment: Consistent on AW late last year, modest overall strike rate (3-56), all wins at this track
runners_data.spotlight: All three Curragh wins have been over shorter; has run okay on occasions over this sort of trip but opposable on balance of form and draw not great.

runners_data.name: Diamond Exchange
runners_data.note: Front-running filly in excellent form wearing cheekpieces, won well here last time and progressive in this grade
runners_data.comment: Ran out of steam on soft ground here a month ago, leading chance now on a quicker surface
runners_data.spotlight: Nicely progressive filly won AW maiden in January and has returned with good efforts in cheekpieces in 1m2f handicaps here, most recently asserting well inside final furlong for head win; 4lb rise okay, needs to find more.

runners_data.name: Cooley's Mist
runners_data.note: Hold-up maiden who showed best form on course and distance debut, entitled to improve after comeback run
runners_data.comment: Fourth of 21 over 1m1f at Leopardstown was his best run for Natalia Lupini; off 8 months
runners_data.spotlight: Fourth of 21 on C&D handicap debut last summer was his best run for Natalia Lupini; no show on last month's Roscommon comeback, entitled to improve for that but an unlikely one.

runners_data.name: Majestic King
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer in excellent recent form with win and second in last two starts, well-weighted for continued progress
runners_data.comment: Effortless Gowran winner on Tuesday; will take all the beating if staying this longer trip
runners_data.spotlight: Well-bred Godolphin cast-off progressing well in handicaps of late, ready winner over 1m at Gowran and three days later staying on second under hefty weight over today's trip at Ballinrobe; runs off 7lb higher mark here so needs to take another step forward, but possible.

runners_data.name: Gotta Catch'em All
runners_data.note: Hold-up 24-race maiden running respectably this season but hard to fancy for breakthrough performance
runners_data.comment: Maiden after 23 runs; placed seven times, two respectable runs this season, place chance
runners_data.spotlight: 24-race maiden has been running respectably this season but hard to see him breaking his duck here.

runners_data.name: Elusive Duke
runners_data.note: Hold-up course winner returning from 284-day absence, may need this run despite previous course success
runners_data.spotlight: C&D winner a year ago for Kevin Coleman off 58; absent since beaten favourite at Naas in August so may need this.

runners_data.name: Lough Leane
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer who got first turf win last month over this trip, 6lb higher but showed good acceleration
runners_data.comment: Won well over a longer trip at Ballinrobe last week, previously best known for his AW wins
runners_data.spotlight: All six wins in Britain came on the AW; first success on turf came last month over this trip at Ballinrobe, quickening off a slow pace, despite racing keenly; 6lb rise but remains on a workable mark.

runners_data.name: Lahore Da King
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner who won on soft ground but didn't stay extended 1m2f trips in recent starts, 7lb claimer aboard
runners_data.comment: Useful form at Dundalk, well beaten at the Curragh since a first turf win at Bellewstown
runners_data.spotlight: Back-to-back AW winner in December over 7f and landed Bellewstown handicap (1m, soft) in April but well held both starts since, not looking to stay extended 1m2f at Roscommon latest; opposable off current mark.

races.paceDynamic: Diamond Exchange and Walhaan are the two confirmed front-runners who will contest the early pace, likely creating an honest gallop from the outset. With 16 runners and several prominent racers like Harana, Sonoran, and Coul Dreamer sitting just off the pace, the tempo should be solid throughout. The combination of the testing 1m1f trip on yielding ground and sustained pressure from multiple pace angles will create a searching examination. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can finish strongly, as the early pace duel and large field will set up perfectly for closers to strike late.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Suits Closers
scenarios.trigger: If Diamond Exchange and Walhaan engage in a prolonged speed duel through honest fractions
scenarios.body: The sustained early pace will soften up the leaders and prominent racers, allowing the patient hold-up horses to unleash finishing kicks in the final two furlongs. The yielding ground will further aid the late-running brigade who can pick up the pieces.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front-Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Diamond Exchange gets an uncontested lead and dictates comfortable fractions
scenarios.body: The progressive filly can control the tempo in her cheekpieces and kick clear when the pressure mounts, utilizing her recent course form and improved rating. Her recent assertive win here gives her tactical confidence to repel late challenges.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Racer Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is moderate and prominent runners get the perfect trip tracking the leaders
scenarios.body: Horses like Sonoran and Harana can position ideally behind any early skirmishing before launching their bids approaching the final furlong. Their tactical positioning allows them to avoid trouble while staying close enough to strike.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Benefits From Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the large field creates significant traffic problems and interference in the straight
scenarios.body: A horse drawn wide or held up can avoid the inevitable shuffling and find clear running when others are stopped in their tracks. The competitive handicap nature means any horse getting a clear passage could outrun their odds.

watchPoints.text: Diamond Exchange and Walhaan must be monitored closely for the early pace battle that will determine the entire race complexion
Booyea needs clear running room in the straight as a hold-up horse in a large competitive field where traffic problems are likely
Elusive Duke returning from 284-day absence may need this run despite being a previous course and distance winner
The inside draws could prove problematic if the pace is strong as horses may get shuffled back in the large field
Majestic King's quick turnaround of three days between his last two races may catch up with him under pressure

races.name: Leopardstown Premier Lounge Handicap

runners_data.name: Two And Two
runners_data.note: Confirmed front runner returning from 81-day break, suited by uncontested lead scenario
runners_data.spotlight: Made all in 6f Dundalk 3yo contest in January and showed speed (hooded) for a long way in Curragh handicap over same trip on opening day of season before fading in heavy ground; back from a break and upped in trip with headgear left off.

runners_data.name: Glamazon
runners_data.note: Prominent racer from in-form Harrington yard, faded when forcing pace last time but better positioned here
runners_data.comment: Retains existing mark after Roscommon maiden win leaving her 7lb out of the handicap
runners_data.spotlight: Well exposed before Ballinrobe maiden win last month (1m1f) and faded tamely after forcing much of pace back in handicap company at the Curragh when racing from 7lb out of the handicap; drops in grade but remains vulnerable to improvers.

runners_data.name: Cosmic Funk
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer with strong recent form, needs genuine pace to be effective from rear
runners_data.comment: All four runs have been over 7f/1m; needs to improve for this step up in trip
runners_data.spotlight: Last Friday's step up in trip at Down Royal didn't bring any improvement; back in trip for handicap debut (down 2lb in future).

runners_data.name: Almeiyda
runners_data.note: Weld-trained prominent runner making handicap debut, didn't stay 1m2f last time so trip suits
runners_data.spotlight: Didn't appear to stay extended 1m2f at Gowran last month in what looked a decent maiden; could still have more to offer and capable of going well off this opening mark.

runners_data.name: Nicky Larson
runners_data.note: Showed promise on handicap debut, benefits from 7lb claimer reducing weight to effective 128lbs
runners_data.comment: Moderate maiden form; may do better now entering handicaps
runners_data.spotlight: Good start to handicapping when chasing home a clear-cut winner over this trip at Limerick in April (yielding); just 1lb higher and rider now claims 7lb so one to consider.

runners_data.name: De Songbird
runners_data.note: Hold-up maiden making handicap debut from wide draw, hard to recommend
runners_data.comment: No real threat in maidens both here and at Naas last month; eligible for a mark after this
runners_data.spotlight: No real threat in three maiden runs within a month in the spring; wide draw for handicap debut and hard to make a case for.

runners_data.name: Chirac
runners_data.note: In-form handicapper who won well at Gowran on soft, proven hold-up performer on this ground
runners_data.comment: Took a step in the right direction with fourth over 5f on turf/handicap debut, solid form
runners_data.spotlight: Has taken well to handicapping, good fourth to an improver over 5f at Naas before relishing step up to 7f for ready success at Gowran (soft) in April, coming late off a good pace; good chance he'll stay 1m and 7lb rise looks fair; decent draw too.

runners_data.name: Themis
runners_data.note: Irish Oaks entry suggests ability but poor recent form, hold-up style needs pace collapse
runners_data.spotlight: Three runs have amounted to little, poor run at Dundalk last time; Irish Oaks entry is unrealistic but evidently held in some regard so could make an impact on handicap debut off a modest mark.

runners_data.name: Bear Right
runners_data.note: Struggling handicapper with no impact in recent starts, hard to recommend
runners_data.comment: Modest form in maidens and on h'cap debut, clipped heels latest, too soon to write off
runners_data.spotlight: Yet to make an impact in handicaps, not looking to get home on soft over this trip at Cork on latest; plenty to find.

runners_data.name: Cameclose
runners_data.note: Failed to stay longer trips recently, cheekpieces replace blinkers for first time
runners_data.comment: Fourth of six at Dundalk in his first handicap, has a bit to find with runner-up Musashi
runners_data.spotlight: Back in trip here after not looking to stay at Killarney; cheekpieces replace blinkers; others preferred.

runners_data.name: Down The Glen
runners_data.note: Former nursery winner who should appreciate drop back to 1m from extended distances
runners_data.comment: Nursery winner on heavy ground last season, longer trip stretched his stamina at Sligo
runners_data.spotlight: 7f Galway nursery winner on heavy ground last season; extended 1m2f seemed too far at Sligo on latest, so should appreciate this drop back in distance.

runners_data.name: Love Orchid
runners_data.note: Ordinary handicap record, first-time cheekpieces the main positive angle
runners_data.comment: Beaten 9l on h'cap debut and seasonal return, sharper now, better ground could suit
runners_data.spotlight: Minor promise in maidens last year but opening two handicap efforts this season have been ordinary; first-time cheekpieces will need to bring improvement to feature.

runners_data.name: No More Hiding
runners_data.note: Returning from 142-day break with new jockey, previously hung left badly
runners_data.spotlight: Tried over different trips in four AW runs over the winter, final occasion hung badly left in straight when well held on handicap debut; Billy Lee takes over for turf debut, interesting if any market support arrives.

runners_data.name: Jp's Express
runners_data.note: Making debut over 1m from poor draw, all previous runs over shorter trips
runners_data.spotlight: All runs have been over shorter trips, never counting after slow start on handicap debut at Naas last time; upped in trip and dropped 7lb; poor draw.

runners_data.name: Wicklow Gap
runners_data.note: Improved last time in tongue-tie, wide draw major tactical disadvantage
runners_data.comment: No impact in first two handicaps at Dundalk last year, tongue tie on, others preferred
runners_data.spotlight: Last month's Roscommon run his best yet, good fourth after not clear run in first-time tongue-tie; claims if overcoming this wide draw.

runners_data.name: Balance Of Trade
runners_data.note: Strong-finishing fourth on Monday despite slow start, 3lb wrong at weights
runners_data.comment: 0-10, best form on soft and heavy ground, needs rain, chance if it arrives
runners_data.spotlight: 11-race maiden but caught the eye at Gowran on Monday when strong-finishing fourth, having lost plenty of ground at the start when hampered; officially 3lb wrong here but could go well at a price.

runners_data.name: Only One Scobie
runners_data.note: Struggling maiden with poor recent form, hard to recommend despite weight drop
runners_data.comment: Ordinary form so far in maidens and on handicap debut latest, others preferred
runners_data.spotlight: Beaten only a couple of rivals in two handicap efforts; handicapper relenting but remains opposable.

races.paceDynamic: Two And Two looks the only confirmed front runner in this 17-runner field, with Glamazon, Almeiyda and Nicky Larson likely to settle prominently behind. The yielding ground and competitive handicap nature suggests Two And Two can dictate at a steady gallop without serious pressure through the early stages. With most of the field showing hold-up tendencies and several runners noted for fading finishes, this race shape clearly favours prominent racers and those with tactical speed who can position close to the pace early.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Front Running
scenarios.trigger: If Two And Two gets an easy lead with minimal early pressure
scenarios.body: The pace becomes too slow for the large hold-up contingent to make up ground, allowing the pace-setters to control the finish. Prominent racers who can quicken from close range will have decisive tactical advantages.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Moderate Early Pace
scenarios.trigger: If Glamazon and Almeiyda press Two And Two from the start
scenarios.body: A more genuine gallop develops that still favours those racing handy, but gives the better hold-up horses a chance if they have class. The Weld and Harrington horses can use their quality from prominent positions.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Strong Gallop Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If multiple prominent runners go hard early creating honest fractions
scenarios.body: The pace becomes searching enough to set up the race for strong-finishing hold-up horses with stamina. Several runners have shown ability to close when the pace is right.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Sprint Finish Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely in the final two furlongs
scenarios.body: The race becomes a pure sprint from the three-furlong pole, suiting those with natural speed regardless of position. Class horses with turn of foot can come from anywhere.

watchPoints.text: Two And Two breaking smoothly from the gates - if he misses the break, the whole pace scenario changes dramatically
Balance Of Trade's start - he lost significant ground when hampered on Monday and needs a clean beginning to show his finishing kick
Wicklow Gap's ability to overcome stall 17 - the tongue-tie worked well last time but the wide draw creates major tactical problems
Glamazon's early positioning - if she forces the pace again like at Curragh, she may set it up for others
The yielding ground conditions affecting the hold-up horses - several have question marks about getting home on this surface
